askContent.answerDescription: Get precise information from your documents
askContent.summarizeDescription: Turn long documents into clear summaries
askContent.dataDescription: Query tables, code snippets and datasets
askContent.sourcesDescription: Combine multiple files and data sources
askContent.tip2: Reference a file or collection if needed
askContent.step1Text: Write a question in your own words, and choose where to look: every collection or one.
askContent.step2Text: It looks for the passages of your documents that answer, by meaning, and by words when your question holds a code or a number.
askContent.step3Text: The answer is written only from those passages, and each claim points to the passage it comes from.
askContent.step4Text: Open a passage to read it in its document, at the right page. Nothing leaves your computer except what the model you chose needs to write the answer.

askReadiness.meaningOffText: Ask finds passages by their words only, so a question that does not use the words of the documents can find nothing.
